applicability.reason: RedactGuard has critical Android document-protection journeys and a cross-process Local AI boundary whose complete outcomes require E2E evidence, while emulator and physical-device evidence support materially different claims.

target_environments.description: A built RedactGuard APK installed on a supported Android device and exercised through production app surfaces, Android document APIs and process-local privacy behavior.
material_dimensions: built APK install and Android process lifecycle
production Compose UI and Android framework behavior
text/PDF ingestion review redaction export and reopen behavior

target_environments.description: RedactGuard and Harnex installed as exact same-signer APKs on a physical Android target, with the Consumer SDK/Binder boundary and real Harness-owned runtime/model path active.
material_dimensions: real Consumer SDK Binder and cross-process lifecycle
real model runtime device ABI and Android process behavior

execution_environments.artifact_surface: built RedactGuard debug APK plus AndroidTest APK using production UI/document/redaction/export code and deterministic analysis
known_gaps: emulator does not establish physical OEM/accessibility/performance/thermal behavior

execution_environments.platform: GitHub-hosted Linux + Android API 35 x86_64 emulator
execution_environments.artifact_surface: separately built same-signer Harnex and RedactGuard APKs using the real Consumer SDK/Binder/control-plane/runtime orchestration with deterministic native execution
known_gaps: x86_64 does not execute production arm64 llama.cpp/JNI

execution_environments.artifact_surface: exact RedactGuard and Harnex APKs with signer/source/preset identity and real Consumer/Binder/runtime path
known_gaps: one device does not establish every supported OEM/API/device combination

critical_journeys.claim: User can paste text, choose protection, run local analysis, review findings, redact or ignore and reach a valid export without exposing sensitive values by default.
residual_gaps: production ARM64 JNI/GGUF and physical OEM/accessibility remain release evidence

critical_journeys.claim: User can import a text PDF, analyze locally, review findings, export the redacted PDF and reopen the expected redactions.
residual_gaps: physical document-provider/OEM behavior remains release evidence

critical_journeys.claim: When local AI is unavailable the user sees an actionable state and the real Consumer/Binder path reconnects after Host availability/restart without reinstalling or exposing partial findings.
residual_gaps: production ARM64 native/model/resource recovery remains physical

critical_journeys.claim: Backgrounding and returning does not implicitly cancel or duplicate accepted Harnex-backed work; the same process-local job remains authoritative.
RedactGuard crosses the real Consumer SDK/Binder boundary and remains recoverable across Host absence/restart.
